metadata.title: Duo-Mode GUI Guardrails — Disable Excess Seat Buttons & Add Duo Title
metadata.author: Denis
metadata.purpose: Fix the web GUI so that, when the engine is launched in Duo mode (2 players), the start-screen buttons for selecting 3 and 4 human players are disabled, and the title in the top-left corner shows a 'Duo' suffix ('Blokus Duo'). Both behaviours are derived from data already exposed by the /state endpoint, with no backend changes.
metadata.approach: Test-Driven Development (superpowers:test-driven-development skill), following the repo's existing 'static GUI test' convention (assert on the contents of gui.js / game.html / style.css).

conversation.content: Check the gui implementation in our blokus engine. There are two modes: classic and duo, however in gui buttons for selecting 3 - 4 players are clickable in duo mode, which doesn't make sense. Make them disabled in duo mode and also add a Duo suffix to the title in left corner if the gui is launched in duo mode.

conversation.summary: Explored the web GUI (src/static/gui.js, src/templates/game.html, src/static/style.css) and the FastAPI orchestrator. Established that the mode is selected at launch via the --duo flag (DUO_CONFIG_JSON: 14x14, player_count=2, scoring_rule='duo') and that the /state endpoint already exposes both 'scoring_rule' and a 'players' array sized to the configured player count — even before the game starts. Confirmed via a FastAPI TestClient probe that Duo returns scoring_rule='duo' with 2 players and Classic returns 'classic' with 4. Implemented the fix test-first (4 failing static tests -> minimal code -> green), then ran the full suite.
investigation_findings: Mode is launch-time only: src/app.py --duo -> mode='duo' -> DUO_CONFIG_JSON in web_main.py/bootstrap.py.
/state already returns 'scoring_rule' (src/adapters/web_orchestrator.py) and 'players' derived from session.remaining_pieces, which is keyed 0..player_count-1, so it is populated on the start screen.
Start buttons use data-human-players attributes (1..4); /start already validates 1<=humans<=player_count server-side, so this change is a UX guardrail over existing validation.
The repo tests the GUI via 'static' tests that assert on the JS/HTML/CSS file text (no headless browser); followed that convention.
An existing .start-option:disabled rule used 'cursor: wait' (the transient busy state), so a distinct '.start-option.disabled' class was needed for the permanently-unavailable (mode-capped) buttons.
design_decisions: Drove the disabling from the configured player count (state.players.length) rather than hard-coding '3 and 4', so it stays data-driven (consistent with AGENTS.md 'configuration is data, not constants'); Duo's 2-player config naturally greys out seats 3 and 4.
Detected Duo via state.scoring_rule === 'duo' for the title, the same signal the engine already serialises.

Gave the title span an id ('brand-name') and set its text to 'Blokus Duo' / 'Blokus' from a new updateModeLabels(state) called inside loadState(), so it is correct on the start screen and stays in sync with the existing 2s polling.
Refactored setStartBusy into refreshStartOptions() + a startBusy flag so the transient 'busy' disabling (during a /start request) and the permanent mode-cap disabling cannot overwrite each other.
Added a '.start-option.disabled' CSS rule (cursor: not-allowed, dimmed, no hover lift) — higher specificity than ':disabled' so the mode-capped look wins over the 'busy' look.

changes.change: Added id="brand-name" to the Blokus title in the masthead-left so JS can update it.

Added module state maxHumanSeats / startBusy; added refreshStartOptions() (disables and marks any [data-human-players] button whose value exceeds maxHumanSeats); rewrote setStartBusy() to delegate to it; added updateModeLabels(state) (sets brand title to 'Blokus Duo' when scoring_rule==='duo' and caps maxHumanSeats to state.players.length); called updateModeLabels(state) early in loadState().
Added .start-option.disabled (cursor: not-allowed, opacity 0.5, no transform/shadow) plus a no-op hover/focus override, distinct from the existing .start-option:disabled 'cursor: wait' busy style.

New static test file (4 tests): brand-name id present in HTML; gui.js adds the 'Blokus Duo' suffix from state.scoring_rule; gui.js disables seat buttons via maxHumanSeats/refreshStartOptions; CSS defines .start-option.disabled.

verification: RED: new test file failed 4/4 for 'feature missing' before implementation.
GREEN: new test file passes 4/4 after implementation.
Runtime contract via FastAPI TestClient on /state before start — Duo: scoring_rule='duo', players=2; Classic: scoring_rule='classic', players=4.
notes: AGENTS.md says 'Milestone 2 (Duo) is out of scope', but Duo mode is already fully present in the codebase (--duo flag, DUO_CONFIG_JSON, DuoScoring); that note is stale and the user explicitly requested this work, so user instruction takes precedence. No new Duo-named module paths were introduced.
No commit was made (not requested); the repo workflow is feature-branch + PR, no direct commits to main.
